rationale: C05 is a highly plausible material drafting template. It uses the same plural-dispute formulation, the same three regional Carriers' Conference Committees, an attached multiregional carrier list, and virtually identical findings, reporting deadline, and statutory status-quo provision. The child adapts that machinery to the Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad and the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen. C20 and C18 are also strong structural precedents, but C05 is the closest recent predecessor in wording, organization, and carrier-list apparatus.

shared_material.child_excerpt: disputes exist between the Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad and other carriers represented by the Eastern, Western and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees, designated in list attached hereto and made a part hereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: disputes exist between the Albany Port District Railroad and other carriers represented by the Eastern, Western and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees, designated in list A attached hereto and made a part hereof
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces the distinctive opening construction, changing the lead railroad and simplifying the list designation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS these disputes have not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS these disputes, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threaten substantially to interrupt interstate commerce
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS these disputes have not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS these disputes, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threaten substantially to interrupt interstate commerce
shared_material.explanation: The factual and legal predicates are reproduced essentially verbatim and in the same sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said disputes within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The operative reporting requirement is the same, apart from singular/plural usage.

shared_material.child_excerpt: no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad Company and other carriers represented by the Eastern, Western and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees or their employees in the conditions out of which the said disputes arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Albany Port District Railroad and other carriers represented by the Eastern, Western and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees or their employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The child directly adapts the parent's section 10 status-quo clause by substituting the lead carrier.
